web-guide-idea-72.audience: People who want better photos without buying a camera.
web-guide-idea-72.offer: Teach framing and light through small exercises with ordinary objects. Everyone should make and compare their own images.
web-guide-idea-72.steps.0: Ask participants to choose one household object.
web-guide-idea-72.steps.1: Try window light and two different compositions.
web-guide-idea-72.steps.2: Review results and repeat the most useful adjustment.
web-guide-idea-72.equipment: A camera phone and an everyday object. A stand is optional.
web-guide-idea-72.returnReason: Explore portraits, food or products in later workshops with different practical exercises.
web-guide-idea-72.promotion: Show two phone photos of the same object and explain the single change.
web-guide-idea-72.metadataTitle: Phone Photography Workshop — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-72.metadataDescription: Practise framing and lighting with a phone and everyday objects available at home. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
